title: ising3d continuous supervisor: independent review turn output
description: Output of a fresh reviewer/verifier-author turn for one produced artifact. The verifier must be independent of the producer (no import of the producer module, different computation path where feasible), read-only, exit 0 only on full PASS, and print the pass_marker line only then.

decision.description: 'verify' runs the named verifier under the resource guard; 'reject' records a failed route (reject_reason required) and no verifier runs.

pass_marker.description: Exact single-line stdout marker printed only on full PASS.

accepted_scope.description: Exactly what a PASS certifies (bounded, finite, no theorem beyond the observed scope).
